notes.title: Update v0.1.6
notes.notes:
[b]v0.1.6[/b]
[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] Trying out reduced turning amount based on speed. Should make steering less sensitive at high speeds.
[*] Slightly increased the hitbox size of pickups and shield towers
[/list]

[h2]UI[/h2]
[list]
[*] Moved Hint Bubbles to a HUD panel instead of world panels
[*] Added icons for bits, datapaks, and shield towers
[/list]

[h2]Visual[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added skybox to all levels (for real this time)
[*] Fixed drift snake particles still showing at max charge
[/list]

[*] Fixed incorrect level select buttons
[/list]

notes.title: Update v0.1.5
notes.notes:
Update v0.1.5
[h1]UI[/h1]
[list]
[*] Tidied up player HUD with backgrounds and outlines
[*] Added Drift Meter to telegraph [ Drift Boost ] charge
[*] Added control hints to Boost and Drift HUD
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*] [ Drift Boost ] now also charges slowly over time in addition to tilt charging.
[*] Added Anti-Stuck reset in case the car gets stuck on an unhoverable surface.
[/list]

[h1]Visual[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added skybox to all levels and added
[*] Added small light props to help telegraph ground vs walls
[*] The Hover Car now very subtly tilts in the direction of gravity
[*] Revised "drip" particles to form a ring around the car
[*] Added boost particles to lights to help telegraph [ Air Boost ]
[*] Drift Particles now only show on the side that is drifting
[/list]

[h1]Levels[/h1]
[list]
[*] Started HUB world ideas and new Level W1-1. Check out the [ Hub World Test ]
[*] Revised Level 3 - Moved it to be Level 5 and added another platform.
[/list]

[h1]Misc[/h1]
[list]
[*] Camera motion when landing is more smooth now
[*] Fixed version watermark not being hidden by F1
[*] Added kiosk mode for showcase purposes
[/list]

notes.title: Update v0.1.4
notes.notes:
[h1]v0.1.4[/h1]
[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] shield towers remaining is now shown on HUD
[*] in-game hints now show what buttons to press based on your bindings
[*] pressing escape or "back" on controller goes back in menus
[/list]
[b]Controls[/b]
[list]
[*] fixed air turn rebind not working
[*] fixed not being able to rebind analog inputs
[*] adding missing rebinding for recentering camera
[*] fixed rebind menus not updating custom rebinds on level load
[*] added a few icons for controller buttons when rebinding
[/list]
[b]Hover Physics[/b]
[list]
[*] adjusted collisions to prevent phasing through floors at shallow angles
[*] adjusted wrap-around-corners force when boosting (most noticeable on level 3)
[/list]
[b]Levels[/b]
[list]
[*] finally centered the bits on level 2
[/list]
[b]Misc[/b]
[list]
[*] fixed being able to pause during level load
[*] fixed "intense" music being much louder than "general" music
[*] lowered default starting volume
[*] music fades out during level load
[/list]
